title: Autumn Apple Empanadas with Chinese Twist
description: A fusion dessert of traditional empanadas filled with caramelized autumn apples and a hint of Chinese spices.
instructions: Roll out empanada dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into circles using a cookie cutter or a glass.
In a pan, caramelize the autumn apples with butter, cinnamon, and honey.
Add Chinese five-spice powder and granulated sugar to the apples. Mix well.
Place a spoonful of the apple mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges with the beaten egg.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
